class.name: PhysXWinch3D
class.brief_description: A vehicle's winch: a cable from a [PhysXVehicle3D] to an anchor, wound in by a motor.
class.description: Add as a direct child of a [PhysXVehicle3D], placed at its fairlead. The cable is a PhysX distance joint that only pulls: its length is the cable paid out, and past it the rope stretches at its axial stiffness. The drum winds in at the line speed its load allows, falling from [member line_speed] with no load to a tenth of it at [member rated_pull], and stalls just past that. The cable is drawn as a catenary from its length and weight, lying on the ground where it would pass under it.

method.name: get_anchor_distance
method.description: The straight distance from the fairlead to the anchor, in metres.

method.name: get_cable_points
method.description: Points along the drawn cable from the fairlead to the anchor, in global space ([param count] segments).

method.name: get_tension
method.description: The cable's tension the last physics step, in newtons.

method.name: line_speed_at
method.description: The line speed the motor manages at [param pull] newtons.

members.member: The anchor: a physics body (a tree's or rock's static body), another [PhysXVehicle3D], or any [Node3D] as a fixed point. Empty: [member anchor_point] in global space.
Where the cable is fixed, in the anchor's own space (global space with no anchor).
The cable is hooked to the anchor. Unhooked, it is reeled in and carries nothing.
The drum brake holds up to this many times [member rated_pull]; past it the cable pays out.
The cable paid out, in metres. 0 when attached: the distance to the anchor plus a little slack.
The cable's mass per metre (9.5 mm steel wire rope; a synthetic rope is about 0.06), for its sag.
The drawn cable's material; a dull steel when empty.
The rope's axial stiffness EA, in newtons; the joint's spring is EA over the cable's length.
What the drum does: holds, winds in, or free spools.
The line speed with no load, in m/s.
All the cable on the drum, in metres.
The rated pull, in newtons (10,000 lb). The line slows to a tenth of [member line_speed] there and stalls just past it.

constants.constant: The brake holds the cable (it slips past [member brake_hold]).
Free spool: the cable pays out as it is pulled.
